b: The lineup for Coachella 2027 just dropped, and it’s a bill that leans hard on the dance floor. Dua Lipa, Tame Impala, and SZA will headline the festival’s Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, respectively, across two weekends, while Daddy Yankee will headline the “In The Desert” special production. The festival runs April 9 to 11 and April 16 to 18 at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California.

Madonna will perform in the Dance Tent, where she made her Coachella debut 20 years ago in support of her 2005 opus Confessions on Dance Floor. The pop legend made a guest appearance during Sabrina Carpenter’s Coachella set earlier this year, debuting their song “Bring Your Love,” from Confessions II.

This will be Lipa’s first time topping the Coachella bill, and her first proper set at the festival since she popped up during Martin Garrix’s performance in 2017. Tame Impala returns to the headliner slot for the first time since 2019, touring behind last year’s Deadbeat, while SZA closes each weekend.

The undercard is just as stacked. In addition to Madonna, Zara Larsson, Steve Lacy, Jisoo, Diljit Dosanjh, Peggy Gou, Kehlani, Giorgio Moroder, and Social Distortion will make appearances on Friday. Saturday features Phoebe Bridgers, Weezer, Tiësto, Garrix, Robyn, Måneskin, Underworld, Leon Bridges, and Magdalena Bay. And Sunday includes Don Toliver, Dom Dolla, Kygo, Empire of the Sun, Four Tet, the Neighbourhood, Becky G, Tove Lo, Victoria Monét, and Caroline Polachek.
Festival passes go on sale Friday, November 13, at noon PT through Coachella’s website.
